text: {"answerable": true, "answer": "The held-out property DiffTRe's coarse-grained water model got wrong was the self-diffusion coefficient D. The model predicted D = 10.91 μm2/ms, versus the experimental D̃ = 2.2 μm2/ms [W3168247670#017]. The paper attributes this to coarse-graining: smoother PESs make CG models exhibit accelerated dynamical processes compared to atomistic models, and diffusion coefficients decrease with more interaction sites in CG water models [W3168247670#017]. The other held-out property, the tetrahedral order parameter q ≈ 0.569, closely matched the experimental 0.576 [W3168247670#017]."}
